blocks.explanation:
Is dafa cosine term ek quadratic (parabola) ke barabar hai. Dono ki shakal bilkul mukhtalif hai, is liye algebra se nahi, graph se hal karenge.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur interval \([-\pi, \pi]\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(x\) jahan wave \(y = 2\cos x\) aur parabola \(y = x^2 + 2x - 1\) milte hain.
Plan: parabola ka square complete kar ke vertex nikalein, table banayein, graph kheenchein, crossings parhein, pakka karein aur check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2\cos x = x^2 + 2x - 1\), \(x \in [-\pi, \pi]\).
Maloom karna: interval ke saare roots.
Tareeqa: \(y = 2\cos x\) aur \(y = x^2 + 2x - 1\) ko ek hi axes par plot karenge aur intersections parhenge. Farq \(d = 2\cos x - (x^2 + 2x - 1)\) ka sign madad karega.

Har graph ki shakal
\(y = 2\cos x\): amplitude 2; \(x = 0\) par 2, \(x = \pm\frac{\pi}{2}\) par 0 aur \(x = \pm\pi\) par \(-2\).
Parabola ka square complete karein:
\[x^2 + 2x - 1 = (x + 1)^2 - 2\]
yani yeh ooper ki taraf khulne wala parabola hai, vertex (sab se neecha point) \((-1, -2)\) aur y-intercept \(-1\).
Kyun: Square complete karne se vertex seedha nazar aa jata hai: \((x + 1)^2\) kabhi negative nahi hota, is liye sab se kam value \(-2\) hai jab \(x = -1\). Cosine wave \(-2\) aur 2 ke beech rehti hai, to crossing sirf wahan ho sakti hai jahan parabola bhi \(-2\) aur 2 ke beech ho. Is se andaza ho jata hai ke do crossings hongi, ek vertex ke bayen aur ek dayen.

Table of values (radians, 2 decimal)
\(x = -\pi\): \(2\cos x = -2\), \(x^2 + 2x - 1 = 2.59\), \(d = -4.59\)
\(x = -2.5\): \(-1.60\), \(0.25\), \(d = -1.85\)
\(x = -2\): \(-0.83\), \(-1\), \(d = 0.17\)
\(x = -1\): \(1.08\), \(-2\), \(d = 3.08\)
\(x = 0\): \(2\), \(-1\), \(d = 3\)
\(x = 0.5\): \(1.76\), \(0.25\), \(d = 1.51\)
\(x = 1\): \(1.08\), \(2\), \(d = -0.92\)
\(x = 2\): \(-0.83\), \(7\), \(d = -7.83\)
Kyun: \(d\) ka sign do dafa badalta hai: \(-2.5\) aur \(-2\) ke darmiyan, aur 0.5 aur 1 ke darmiyan. \(x = 1\) ke baad parabola tezi se ooper chala jata hai (7, 15.15) jab ke cosine neeche aata hai, is liye wahan koi aur crossing nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(x^2\) mein negative \(x\) rakhte waqt bracket lagayein: \((-2.5)^2 = 6.25\), \(-6.25\) nahi.

Graph bana kar intersections parhein
Figure mein parabola cosine wave ko do jagah kaat'ta hai:
\[x \approx -2.04,\ 0.83\]
Kyun: Do intersection points, yani do roots.

2 decimal tak pakka karein
\(d(-2.045) = -0.005\), \(d(-2.035) = +0.033\)
\(d(0.825) = +0.027\), \(d(0.835) = -0.025\)
Kyun: Har jore mein sign badalta hai, is liye roots (asal mein \(-2.0436\ldots\) aur \(0.8302\ldots\)) round ho kar \(-2.04\) aur \(0.83\) bante hain.

Tasdeeq
\(x = -2.04\): \(2\cos x = -0.904\), \(x^2 + 2x - 1 = -0.918\)
\(x = 0.83\): \(1.350\) aur \(1.349\)
Kyun: Dono roots par dono sides takreeban 0.01 tak barabar hain, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x \approx -2.04,\ 0.83\) radians
Yani interval mein do roots hain.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = 2 cos x (blue wave: minus 2 at both ends, 2 at x = 0) and the upward parabola y = x squared + 2x minus 1 (pink, vertex at (minus 1, minus 2)) on minus pi to pi. They meet at two marked points, at x about minus 2.04 and 0.83.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(x = -2.04\) aur \(0.82\) radians likha hai. Doosra root asal mein \(x = 0.8302\ldots\) hai (\(d(0.825) = +0.027\), \(d(0.835) = -0.025\)), jo round ho kar \(0.83\) banta hai. \(x = 0.82\) par dono sides \(1.364\) aur \(1.312\) hain, barabar nahi. Sahi jawab: \(x \approx -2.04,\ 0.83\) radians.
